title: 第17章 重击第18章 来者不善
content_zh:
第十七章 重击
私厅位于店铺最里面，从前堂过去中间夹着炼房和仓库，不过炼房和仓库分别位于左右边，中间有条通行的路，连通最里面的私厅。
当初设计整个店铺的时候，叶石留下最大面积的，不是前堂，更不是炼房和仓库，而是私厅。这不是叶石奢侈，而是因为店铺中的私厅有其他妙用。
例如，在私厅的房间里，可以加速血量和魔量的恢复，而且在私厅中学习技能，会获得更多的经验，从而加速技能的升级。最重要的是，这私厅中设置了一个修炼大堂，是模拟做战用的，可以模拟出一个对手。
这个功能都是武器店铺才会提供的，用的是给买武器的玩家第一时间试用武器，最重要的一点，就是因为还在店铺内，所以剑可以试过以后再买。
而这个在《巅峰》玩家里都知道的事情，在这里可没人知晓，所以叶石干脆就装作不知道。不过现在叶石可不打算掖着，不用来试剑，用来修炼也可以的。
当初叶石可是将这个修炼大堂当做PK对手，没事拿着剑和模拟对手乱砍，为的是参加整个游戏系统举办的店铺店主PK大赛，胜利者可是有十万金币，那时候叶石正处于缺钱状态，当然不会放过，可惜还没来得及参加，就穿越过来了。
领着张羊来到修炼大堂，这里尽管不像房间那样恢复力强，但也会缓慢的恢复消耗。不过张羊精神饱满，所以感觉不出来，而叶石因为铸剑有所消耗的缘故，所以能够感觉到那奇妙的感觉，心里压住兴奋，果然功能还没有消失。
“大哥，你带我来这空房子做什么？”张羊环视房内一圈，首先这个房间很大，然后是这个房间很空，这样的地方还不如破开屋顶，变成一个院落，最起码也能晒晒日光，吹吹风吧。
当然，源自对叶石的信任，张羊不会觉得大哥是无故带自己过来，这才发出了疑问。至于后面的想法，是身为世家子弟一个正常的想法，比起在一个房间里练剑，还不如在院落里，阳光充足，风气凉爽，连空气也清新许多。
“先不要问，等会你就知道了。”叶石卖了一个关子，即便要模拟对手出来对战，也要先把技能教给张羊不是。
而在这个修炼大堂里，领悟技能会容易许多，叶石是怕凭借张羊自己还领悟不来，所以才下了猛料。至于最后面的模拟对手，这是一个不能暴露的秘密，可是叶石会忽悠不是，编个理由说是朋友之类的糊弄过去就得了。
要是别人可能会看出点端倪，但对于张羊，叶石可是彻底放心。这不单是源自张羊对他的信任，重要的是叶石看出了张羊的单纯，即便是和他明说这是一个模拟出来的对手，怕是张羊也以为是在开玩笑吧。
“好了，把你的巨崛剑拿好，要开始咯。”叶石说道，说完也拿出一柄巨剑。
除了那雪白的剑身外，竟然模样上和巨崛剑有九成相似，而且也不见叶石有什么动作，之前没见到叶石带剑，这巨剑似乎就是凭空变出来的。
事实上变确实是变，但不是凭空，而是这剑一直以软剑的模样缠在叶石的腰上。软剑细而软，依靠一种特定的战术可以发挥奇妙无比的威力，更重要的是它能别在腰间，做到出奇不意的攻击效果。
可惜的是游戏里使用软剑的人极少，叶石才没有存货，不过甚至软剑妙用无穷的叶石便把自己的剑变成软剑缠在腰间，这样也就不用怕那些发觉自己被忽悠的人前来报复了。
而软剑如何能在一瞬间变成巨剑，而且模样和巨崛剑有九成相似，这都源自于当初铸剑时叶石投下的一种高级特殊矿石。尽管只是高级特殊矿石，但实际上它的妙用比起极品矿石都要强，甚至曾经在拍卖会上拍出高于极品矿石十倍的价格，这个高级特殊矿石便是云变石。
加入云变石的剑，可以在原有剑态下拥有另外三种形式的剑态，随着持剑者的心意任意在四种剑态中变化，并且拥有该种剑态的所有特性，就连附加属性也会因此变化，在诡变的剑斗中，这样的剑可以说是最诡异的。
不过加入云变石的剑会有一个特性，就是剑身雪白，和别的剑在外观有略微的差距，只要细心观察就能辩解而出。可惜的是现在不是在游戏里，怕是连云变石都不一定会有，更别说认出来了。

“大哥，你也用巨剑？”张羊在一旁欢喜的道。
叶石笑而不语，严格来说这云变剑的四种剑态叶石都能够用，而能够成为其中之一的巨剑剑态，叶石当然也很熟练。
神圣铸剑师，除了铸剑术外最大一个特点，就是所有剑态的技能都能够学习，当然只是能够学习而已，是否让技能强大起来，还需要凭借自己的悟性和努力。
张羊见叶石默认了自己的提问，心里兴奋不已，不是因为大哥用巨剑，教他用巨剑会更实用。而是认为大哥和自己一样用巨剑，这样显得更亲近。
叶石自然看出来了，那不是一种对即将学习到的剑技兴奋的表情，不过也正是因为这样，叶石才那么快接受张羊。
“来了，张羊你仔细看清楚。”叶石突然大喝一声，双手紧握巨剑，眼睛直盯着眼前一个方向。
张羊连忙聚精会神，看着叶石的动作。
对叶石来说，使用技能很简单，但这却和张羊说不得，因为说了也没用，只能靠张羊自己观察了，看能否从他动作里模仿出来。
“重击。”随着叶石一声暴喝，在巨剑技能当中最为常见的一招技能使了出来。
重击，可以让巨剑持有者力量瞬间翻倍，使出至重一击，是巨剑技能中最为普遍，且等级最低的一个技能。
巨大的力量仿佛撕裂了空气，发出刺耳的鸣响，如果这一剑落在实处，丝毫不用怀疑其将会受到巨大的伤害。
content_en:
Chapter 17 Heavy blow
The private hall is located at the innermost part of the store. There is a refining room and a warehouse sandwiched between the front hall, but the refining room and the warehouse are located on the left and right sides respectively. There is a road in the middle that connects to the innermost private hall.
When he originally designed the entire store, Ye Shi left the largest area, not the front hall, not the refinery and warehouse, but the private hall. This is not because Ye Shi is extravagant, but because the private room in the store has other wonderful uses.
For example, in the private hall room, you can speed up the recovery of blood volume and mana, and if you learn skills in the private hall, you will gain more experience, thus accelerating the upgrade of skills. The most important thing is that there is a training hall in this private hall, which is used to simulate combat and can simulate an opponent.
This function is only provided by weapon stores. It is used to allow players who buy weapons to try out the weapons for the first time. The most important point is that because it is still in the store, the sword can be tried before buying.
And this is something that everyone in "Apex" knows, but no one here knows about it, so Ye Shi simply pretends not to know. But now Ye Shi doesn't intend to tuck it away, not to use it to test the sword, but to practice.
At the beginning, Ye Shi regarded this training hall as a PK opponent. He used his sword to slash at simulated opponents in order to participate in the store owner PK competition organized by the entire game system. The winner received one hundred thousand gold coins. At that time, Ye Shi was short of money and of course he would not let it go. Unfortunately, he traveled through time before he could participate.
He led Zhang Yang to the training hall. Although the recovery here is not as strong as the room, it will also slowly recover and consume. However, Zhang Yang was full of energy, so he couldn't feel it. However, Ye Shi could feel the wonderful feeling because of the consumption of making the sword. He suppressed his excitement in his heart, and sure enough, the function had not disappeared.
"Brother, why did you bring me to this empty house?" Zhang Yang looked around the room. First of all, this room is very big, and secondly, this room is very empty. It is better to break the roof of such a place and turn it into a courtyard. At least it can get some sunshine and some wind.
Of course, due to his trust in Ye Shi, Zhang Yang would not think that his eldest brother had brought him here for no reason, so he raised questions. As for the latter thought, it is a normal thought for a child of aristocratic family. Compared with practicing swordsmanship in a room, it is better to practice in a courtyard with plenty of sunshine, cool breeze, and even fresher air.
"Don't ask yet, you will know later." Ye Shi made a fool of himself. Even if he wanted to simulate an opponent to fight, he had to teach Zhang Yangbu the skills first.
In this training hall, it would be much easier to comprehend skills. Ye Shi was afraid that Zhang Yang would not be able to comprehend them on his own, so he made a bold move. As for the simulated opponent at the end, this is a secret that cannot be exposed, but Ye Shi knows how to deceive him, so he can just make up an excuse and say he is a friend or something like that.
Others might have seen some clues, but Ye Shi was completely at ease with Zhang Yang. This was not only due to Zhang Yang's trust in him, but more importantly, Ye Shi saw Zhang Yang's innocence. Even if he told him that this was a simulated opponent, Zhang Yang might have thought it was a joke.
"Okay, take your giant sword and let's get started." Ye Shi said, and then he took out a giant sword.
Except for the snow-white sword body, it is 90% similar in appearance to the Giant Sword, and Ye Shi has not been seen making any movements. I have never seen Ye Shi with a sword before, so this giant sword seems to have been conjured out of thin air.
In fact, the change is indeed a change, but it is not out of thin air, but the sword has always been wrapped around Ye Shi's waist like a soft sword. The soft sword is thin and soft. Depending on a specific tactic, it can exert incredible power. More importantly, it can be worn on the waist to achieve unexpected attack effects.
It's a pity that very few people use Ruan Jian in the game, and Ye Shicai doesn't have any inventory, but even Ruan Jian MiaoUsing endless leaf stones, he turned his sword into a soft sword and wrapped it around his waist, so that he would not have to worry about revenge from those who found out that he had been deceived.
And how the soft sword can turn into a giant sword in an instant, and its appearance is 90% similar to the giant sword, all of this comes from a high-grade special ore dropped by Ye Shi when the sword was made. Although it is only a high-grade special ore, it is actually more magical than the top-grade ore. It has even been sold at an auction for ten times the price of the top-grade ore. This high-grade special ore is cloud alexandrite.
A sword added with cloud stone can have three other sword states under the original sword state. It can change among the four sword states at will according to the mind of the sword holder, and has all the characteristics of that sword state. Even the additional attributes will also change accordingly. In the weird sword fight, such a sword can be said to be the weirdest.
However, a sword with cloudite added to it will have a characteristic, that is, the sword body is snow-white, and there is a slight difference in appearance from other swords, which can be explained by careful observation. It's a pity that it's not in the game now, so I might not even have the cloud stone, let alone recognize it.
"Brother, you also use a giant sword?" Zhang Yang said happily from the side.
Ye Shi smiled and said nothing. Strictly speaking, Ye Shi could use all four sword forms of the Yunbian Sword. Of course, Ye Shi was also very skilled in being able to become one of the giant sword sword forms.
Apart from the sword-making skills, the biggest feature of the sacred swordsmith is that he can learn all sword skills. Of course, he can only learn them. Whether he can make his skills powerful depends on his own understanding and hard work.
Zhang Yang was excited when he saw Ye Shi acquiesced to his question, not because his eldest brother used a giant sword, but teaching him to use a giant sword would be more practical. Instead, he thinks that his eldest brother uses a giant sword like him, which makes him look closer.
Ye Shi naturally saw that it was not an expression of excitement about the sword skills he was about to learn, but it was precisely because of this that Ye Shi accepted Zhang Yang so quickly.
"Here we come, Zhang Yang, look carefully." Ye Shi suddenly shouted, holding the giant sword tightly with both hands, staring in the direction in front of him.
Zhang Yang quickly concentrated on watching Ye Shi's movements.
For Ye Shi, using skills is very simple, but this cannot be explained to Zhang Yang, because it is useless to say it. Zhang Yang can only rely on his own observation to see if he can imitate it from his movements.
"Heavy attack." Ye Shi shouted loudly and used one of the most common skills among the giant sword skills.
A heavy blow can instantly double the strength of the giant sword holder, allowing him to deliver the most severe blow. It is the most common and lowest-level skill among the giant sword skills.
The huge force seemed to tear the air apart, making a harsh sound. If the sword fell on the ground, there was no doubt that it would suffer huge damage.
